description: This file implements the MediaEngineRMF plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, media control methods (play, stop, mute, setVolume, setVideoRectangle), event handling, and plugin registration.

classes.name: MediaEngineRMF
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing media control and event handling for MediaEngineRMF.

methods.name: initialize_player
methods.description: Initializes the media platform support for QAM source type.

methods.name: deinitialize_player
methods.description: Deinitializes the media platform support for QAM source type.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Creates and starts media playback for a given source.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and releases resources.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the media player.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level of the media player.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle parameters.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles media events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error events and sends notifications.
